summary: HEAD 177b3ecc9 failed ecosystem-units check --strict (V3): unit.json versions of analyst 0.4.0, maind 0.6.1, skiller 0.19.3 lagged package.json after releases v0.30.2/v0.30.3; synced unit.json to 0.4.1/0.6.2/0.19.6 in P1.1 (out-of-list paths, keeps V3 green).

Registering gui touched hub files outside task_files: scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py (hard module lists), scripts/test-aicore-locator.py and scripts/test-dev-guard.py (gui carriers; locator pythonpath check widened to CARRIERS[:10]), configs/ecosystem-baseline.json (standalone gui pass via --update-baseline), tests/golden cases + cli/swissknifeman-help.txt + swissknifeman-unknown-subcommand.txt (umbrella help lists gui; captured --reason PLAN5.P1.1). No module CHANGELOG (orch has none); no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (managed-blocks empty).
start reported route ROUTE_MODEL_UNKNOWN for actor claude/claude-opus-5-5/high (observed: model claude-opus-5-5, CLAUDE_EFFORT=high); route table does not know the model id.

Design choices: (1) gui.contracts.validate validates a several-kind document against the branch its const discriminator names (same verdict as the whole oneOf, precise codes), so view-data invalid fixtures keep the planned names status.enum, list-without-columns.required, edge-kind.enum; only unknown-view gives one_of. (2) Extra I4 fixture argv-joined-input.one_of. (3) ecosystem-units code UNIT_GUI (neighbours use UNIT_*), also rejects a symlink leaving the unit. (4) Resolver limits fixed in docs/contribution.md#limits for P1.4: gui.json 256 KiB, single-line text 200, description 2000, 200 per list, 64 fields, 64 argv parts, literal 4096, 200 enum values, 500 form annotations.

V1 red on HEAD: harness test_review_gate.test_broken_plan_json_is_a_violation failed because review-gate plan-check.sh found the planner only as PLANNER_PLAN_PY/PLANNER_ROOT/'planner' on PATH while aicore.util.partners (used by the test) also accepts the 'plan.py' link of install.sh; added the plan.py PATH fallback to plan-check.sh (harness, out-of-scope path) + root CHANGELOG Fixed.

Design gaps filled: (1) bootstrap/v1 gets required epoch (stream semantics say bootstrap gives a new epoch) and is a oneOf by mode (desktop requires shell, browser forbids it); (2) stream subscribe gets required epoch (string|null) so a cursor of an old backend process is detectable (-> snapshot_required); (3) run transitions add queued->cancelled and queued|authorizing->lost (I11: every unfinished run becomes lost; a queued run is cancelled without a process); (4) config values exclude null (TOML has none; null in diff = absent) — design said scalar incl. null; (5) contribution/v1 gets $defs/effect (same enum, extracted) so trust/run reference it by URN; (6) errors.RETRYABLE explicit code set instead of per class.

umbrella-units/v1 had only hub-relative roots: added hub_root to scripts/umbrella.py output, configs/schemas/umbrella-units.schema.json (out-of-list path, additive) and scripts/test-umbrella.py. Resolver refinements beyond the design table: two accepted contributions of the same owner conflict (blocks an extension impersonating a hub bridge); route/widget view must equal the query's returns; missing argv[0]/docs index -> CONTRIB_REF_UNKNOWN; duplicates inside one file -> CONTRIB_CONFLICT; catalog digest covers host + (owner, source, digest) without paths (portable). gui check also accepts a bare gui.json (owner rule skipped).
